## Description
Please describe your changes and the rationale behind them. Include relevant issue numbers if applicable.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement / Refactoring

## Contributor Checklist
- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/sealkit/dbseal/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) guide.
- [ ] My code adheres to the project's Go style guidelines (`go fmt`, `golangci-lint`).
- [ ] I have written tests covering my changes and all unit tests pass (`go test ./...`).
- [ ] I have updated documentation or user guides if relevant.
- [ ] My changes do not break backward compatibility unless explicitly discussed.
